lines.text: On the day the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered it, and at night it appeared like fire.
Wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites camped, and when it lingered many days, they did not set out.
Whether the cloud stayed two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped until it was lifted.
The LORD told Moses to make two trumpets of hammered gold, and when both sounded, the whole congregation assembled.
Short blasts sent the eastern camps out, and the sons of Eleazar were to sound the trumpets.
